title: A Dumpling’s Reminiscence
html:
“Hello there! Are you outsiders?”

He was a middle-aged man who looked rather old.

Polite Shin Yoosung stepped forward first and greeted him.

“We’re on our way to the Western Paradise to seek the Buddha.”

“Oh, the Buddha? You’re eminent monks, despite appearances!”

As the middle-aged man marveled, Lee Gilyoung cleared his throat importantly and clasped his hands behind his back.

The old man studied the two children with a curious look, then turned toward me.

“Then this tall, handsome gentleman beside you is also…… Eek!”

His face had turned deathly pale as he stared at the murim dumpling on my shoulder.

“Th-That’s a murim dumpling……!”

“Ah, it’s just a doll. I like dumplings.”

“……Is that so? You gave me a fright.”

Looking shaken, the middle-aged man rubbed his chest. Judging by the armband on his shoulder, he seemed to be the factory’s foreman.

We thought this was a good opportunity and decided to ask him.

“What exactly is this factory? Why are you making so many dumplings here?”

“……Surely you didn’t come here knowing nothing?”

He gave us a troubled look, then let out a deep sigh and spoke.

“This is all the work of a dreadful demon.”

“A demon?”

“Yes. This wasn’t originally a factory complex.”

According to the middle-aged man, a peaceful village had once stood here.

He said that one day, a tall, dark-skinned, hulking pig demon had appeared, abducted all the village’s women, and enslaved the men to build this factory.

“He took both my daughter and my wife as concubines, then locked us up here! As you can see, a special divine power surrounds this factory, preventing the slaves from leaving freely. And that demon eats so much…… Even making dumplings all day, we can barely keep up.”

[The factory’s production system is seeking the ‘foreman’!]

“O-Oh, dear! I must get back.”

Hastily pulling on sanitary gloves and a mask, the middle-aged man headed toward the conveyor belt.

Just as I stepped forward to say something, Shin Yoosung stopped him first.

“It’s wrong to make you men do forced labor like this. And you said the demon abducted the women too. We can’t leave things this way.”

That was my incarnation for you.

Though she had probably done it because that was how the story needed to progress……

“We’ll help you. Where is that demon?”

“Even for monks, that demon is…… Will you truly help?”

“Of course.”

The middle-aged man’s eyes darted around busily before he explained where the demon was.

“Then I’m counting on you! Please, defeat that demon.”

We nodded and moved in the direction he indicated.

(The dumpling demon is at the end of this 「Road of Dumplings」.)

We began walking down the road of dumplings formed by the conveyor belt.

Seemingly unable to resist, Lee Gilyoung kept picking up dumplings and eating them along the way.

“……These are delicious!”

Of course. These were [Murim Dumplings], after all.

But our authority on [Murim Dumplings] seemed to disagree.

—The aroma is strange.

‘What?’

—Give me one.

Following the children, I carefully picked up a dumpling and handed it to the dumpling on my shoulder. The sight of a dumpling tasting a dumpling was deeply grotesque.

—The proportions of the ingredients are wrong. Whoever made this does not seem to have mastered [Murim Dumplings].

Looking displeased, Murim Dumpling [999] began ordering me to do this and that.

—Add another half spoonful from that green container.

We still had a long way to go anyway, so I followed his instructions and put the ingredients into the dumpling wrapper.

—It must be cooked over Samadhi True Fire. Place the steamer with the yellow flames at its center, then heat it.

Perhaps this was a dream.

Walking down a road of dumplings while a dumpling taught me how to make dumplings.

How much farther did I walk along that dreamlike road?

By its end, I had obtained a pack of appetizing murim dumplings.

As [999] nodded triumphantly, I wondered what on earth I had just done.

“I think that’s our destination.”

I looked where Shin Yoosung was pointing.

At the end of the conveyor belt stood a huge stone wall and a passage to another residential area. A few workers were carrying packaged dumplings inside.

That seemed to be where the dumplings were consumed.

As we drew closer, a guard approached us.

“Who goes there?”

Shin Yoosung smiled brightly and answered.

“We humble monks are traveling to the Western Paradise to meet the Buddha and obtain the scriptures, and happened to pass this way. May we come inside?”

“Ah, are you the ‘Tang monk’s party’ I’ve heard about?”

“That’s right.”

Listening to their conversation, I was dumbfounded.

We had started our journey only a few days ago. There was no way word of us had spread this far.

[You have learned of the Story ‘Words Faster than Feet’!]

Once again, Shin Yoosung whispered to me.

“Apparently it was always like this in the original.”

……Ah, was that it?

[Some judges admire the Scenario Master’s knowledge of the original.]

[10 bonus points have been added for outstanding fidelity to the original!]

Even reproducing the original’s implausibility counted as fidelity…… Amazing.

The gatekeeper spoke.

“I’m sorry, but our village doesn’t admit outsiders. Forgive us for making you come all this way, but please go around in another direction…… Gah!”

Apparently the gatekeeper’s speech had gone on too long. Lee Gilyoung punched him in the belly and knocked him out. As if making an excuse, Lee Gilyoung said,

“Let’s just hurry up and beat that demon. Sooyoung-noona said audiences like it when the plot moves fast.”

That bastard Han Sooyoung had taught them such wonderful things.

[Some audience members are satisfied with Tang Sanzang’s judgment.]

[You have earned 1 additional bonus point!]

I turned to Shin Yoosung and Lee Gilyoung and said,

“Then let’s go in.”

“No, ajusshi. You stay right here.”

“Pardon?”

“I told you, Sun Wukong just gets carried here.”

“But……”

“Haa…… I really didn’t want to do this unless I had to.”

Clutching her prayer beads, Shin Yoosung began chanting something.

“Mahaprajnaparamita–Kim Dokja. The Stop-Fooling-Around-and-Stay-Put Heart Sutra……”

……What?

[Tang Sanzang has chanted the ‘Headband-Tightening Incantation (緊箍咒)’!]

[The item ‘Golden Headband (緊箍兒)’ responds!]

With pain that felt as though my skull would split, I passed out on the spot.

●

……So this was the famous ‘Headband-Tightening Incantation’.

When I woke again, Shin Yoosung and Lee Gilyoung had already disappeared into the village. Looking beside me, I saw the dumpling staring at me as though mocking me.

—What will you do?

‘……Follow them.’

Ordinarily, it would be fine to leave it to the two children. They were now incarnations strong enough to manage without my help.

But I had an uneasy feeling.

(If Sun Wukong’s prediction was right, there was only one being they could meet this time.)

It wasn’t as if no one came to mind when I thought of murim dumplings.

But for that person to have become a villain who enslaved people to run a factory and abducted women…… I could not accept it.

(Then someone discovered Sun Wukong.)

“Aaah! A demon!”

I turned and saw several women.

(The women were startled by Sun Wukong’s appearance.)

Pointing at the monkey ears growing amid my golden hair, the women backed away. Then, apparently noticing the dumpling on my shoulder, they spoke up in recognition.

“He must like murim dumplings……”

“……Then is he a good demon?”

I had no idea how that logic worked, but since things had turned out this way, I decided it was convenient.

“Were you abducted, by any chance?”

At my question, the women looked at each other in confusion.

“……Abducted? Nothing like that happened to us.”

“But I heard a demon resembling a black pig abducted you.”

“A pig? Surely…… you don’t mean Bajie-nim?”

……Bajie-nim?

“Our Bajie-nim is a little tanned. But I wouldn’t call him black……”

“Some parts of him do resemble a pig. Those muscular arms, those firm thighs. But he’s different from a pig……”

Something strange was going on.

Just then, a loud commotion rose from the village center, and I ran toward it. It was obvious who was causing it.

“Stop!”

A child’s voice rang out thunderously. Making my way through the crowd of women, I saw a large palanquin in the village square, with two children blocking its path.

Needless to say, they were Lee Gilyoung and Shin Yoosung.

Stepping forward like a tiny general, Lee Gilyoung shouted.

“You’re the demon who abducted the village women and built a dumpling factory to satisfy his own greed!”

[Some audience members praise Tang Sanzang’s cuteness!]

[Judge ‘Successor of Sakyamuni’ adds 5 bonus points.]

……Truly adorable.

Whoever was in that palanquin could never fight a child after hearing lines like that…… No, if it was that bastard, who knew.

The next moment, terrifying Status surged from within the curtained palanquin.

“Lower the palanquin.”

A low-pitched voice came from inside. A voice with the astonishing power to change the entire atmosphere in a single sentence.

Swallowing hard, I approached from behind the children.

“……We told you to stay back because it’s dangerous!”

“Leaving me behind like that is even more dangerous.”

The palanquin’s curtains slowly began drawing back.

And from inside emerged the demon in question.

(Sun Wukong knew who he was.)

(Marshal Tianpeng (天蓬元帥), Zhu Bajie.)

Shin Yoosung’s mouth fell open.

“Zhu Bajie……?”

(Sun Wukong thought something had gone wrong.)

(Because this was not the Zhu Bajie he remembered.)

For a moment, I felt the scales of beauty (美) in this world tip, their weight (錘) shifting.

An absurd roar of cheering poured out.

“Oooooh! Zhu Bajie-nim!”

Certainly, calling something like that a ‘demon’ would not be entirely wrong.

It made no sense for a human to look like that.

Eyebrows like a master painter’s single, flowing brushstroke. Nose and jaw lines extending at such perfect angles that no crude human protractor could dare measure them. Eyes as though every misfortune in the world had been gathered and cut into beautiful jewels.

Anyone who could look at that face without being captivated would be the abnormal one.

Indeed, the villagers were showering him with praise, regardless of age or gender.

“Long live Zhu Bajie-nim!”

“Creator of murim dumplings!”

Wearing a half-open black vest and dark indigo jeans, Zhu Bajie was stepping down from the palanquin.

“At last, the time has come to settle this! You dark bastard!”

Lee Gilyoung shouted triumphantly, as though he had expected it.

Swinging his tiny fists like flaming cans on strings, Lee Gilyoung charged at Zhu Bajie. Of course, he had no chance.

“Let go! You pig!”

Easily lifting Lee Gilyoung by the scruff of his neck, Zhu Bajie glanced at Shin Yoosung, then strode toward me.

“……Are you Sun Wukong?”

Yes, I had suspected from the beginning that this bastard would be Zhu Bajie.

But…… what about him could possibly be called ‘Zhu Bajie’?

[A few audience members cannot understand Zhu Bajie’s appearance.]

[A few audience members protest that this desecrates the original!]

[Judge ‘Meihouwang’ says that is absurd!]

Apparently some audience members actually shared my opinion.

Then, the next moment.

[Many audience members cheer the casting of Zhu Bajie!]

……Huh?

[The vote count increases greatly!]

[The Story chamber’s rank has risen sharply!]

……Surely not?

[Judge ‘Cleanser of Altars (浄壇使者)’ is pleased with his appearance.]

As those familiar with it would know, ‘Cleanser of Altars’ was Zhu Bajie’s modifier.

[Judge ‘Cleanser of Altars’ is extremely pleased with the casting of his role.]

[You have earned 150 additional bonus points!]

As Yoo Joonghyuk glared at me with his characteristic threatening eyes, large lettering appeared before me.

~ Episode 2. Supreme King Zhu Bajie ~

●

[Congratulations! Your Story chamber has entered the top 100.]

Looking at the message before her, Han Sooyoung turned a page with a wry smile.

On the panel, the characters continued their story according to the plot she had devised.

Pushing up her lensless horn-rimmed glasses, Han Sooyoung muttered.

“……The kids’ shitty acting is scaring me to death. Seriously.”

Nevertheless, her Story chamber had already passed a thousand votes and entered the higher ranks.

A knock sounded behind her, and Lee Sookyung entered the room.

“I cut up some fruit.”

“If you’re going to knock, wait for an answer before coming in. Otherwise, don’t bother knocking.”

“How’s the work going?”

“……So-so. Fei Hu’s rank is high, so catching up isn’t easy.”

Checking Han Sooyoung’s chamber rank over her shoulder, Lee Sookyung spoke.

“To rise this much in only a few days is impressive.”

“This is nothing compared to the results I got in my heyday. And we still don’t know how it’ll turn out.”

Steeling her resolve, Han Sooyoung bit into an apple with a crunch.

Beyond the holographic panel, Sun Wukong stood with a dazed expression.

“……From now on, it all depends on how well this Sun Wukong does.”

●

“That’s right. I’m Sun Wukong.”

At my reply, Yoo Joonghyuk stared at me suspiciously.

Then his right eye shone gold.

[‘Detection skills’ are not permitted in this scenario region.]

Because of the world’s restrictions, his [Sage’s Eye] did not activate.

I had expected this, so I was not surprised.

“You shoot something like lasers from your eye.”

I said it with a smile.

If things followed the original, Zhu Bajie was destined to become my junior martial brother anyway.

“Shin Yoosung! What are you standing there for? Hurry up and beat this bastard!”

Dangling in midair, Lee Gilyoung shrieked.

Shin Yoosung glanced at him as though it had nothing to do with her, then asked Zhu Bajie,

“However much you like murim dumplings, building a factory and enslaving people! And why on earth did you abduct the women?”

Listening to Shin Yoosung, I looked around.

「In the original ‘Journey to the West’, Zhu Bajie is a demon king of lust and gluttony.」

Considering the original’s characterization, this was not an impossible episode.

But however much Han Sooyoung hated Yoo Joonghyuk, I doubted she would simply follow the original. She had even changed ‘Ways of Survival’ so meticulously.

Besides, even if she had written that scenario, there was no way that Yoo Joonghyuk would obediently follow it……

“I did not abduct the women.”

At Yoo Joonghyuk’s words, the surrounding women shouted.

“That’s right. We weren’t abducted!”

I studied their expressions. None of their eyes looked enthralled.

Lee Gilyoung shouted.

“So what! You captured the villagers and made them churn out dumplings for you to eat!”

Right. That was certainly what the factory slave had said.

But one thing did not make sense.

Yoo Joonghyuk liked ‘Murim Dumplings’. No, it was almost an obsession.

Would Yoo Joonghyuk, of all people, really eat something from a factory like that?

「“I don’t eat things made by other people.”」

It made no sense for Yoo Joonghyuk, who had gone so far as to say that, to use slaves just so he could eat factory-made dumplings.

As if proving it, Yoo Joonghyuk spoke in a slightly sorrowful tone.

“I did not eat the ‘Murim Dumplings’.”

“What the hell are you talking about, you dumpling psycho! Shin Yoosung, hurry up and do something!”

Instead of answering, Yoo Joonghyuk was looking beyond the crowd around him.

Dozens of houses stood along the lanes. Delivered murim dumplings were piled at their entrances. Children clustered together in the yards, happily unwrapping and eating the heaped dumplings.

“……Could it be?”

Then a warning message appeared throughout the village.

[A revolution has broken out at the ‘dumpling factory’!]

The village entrance where the gatekeeper had stood collapsed, and the factory slaves swarmed in.

“We won’t do forced labor anymore!”

“Dumplings here, dumplings there! Nothing but dumplings everywhere!”

“Kill him! Kill that pig!”

Wicked light flashed in the eyes of the slaves, each carrying a hoe or rake.

The frightened women shouted.

“Those demons still haven’t learned their lesson!”

“Demons? He’s the demon!”

Still failing to grasp the situation, Lee Gilyoung shouted.

Yoo Joonghyuk, who had set him down by now, was looking grim.

“……Should I have killed them in the first place after all?”

At that moment, I thought I understood what had happened.

I was currently Sun Wukong.

Which meant I might be able to borrow his power.

Looking at the approaching demons, I focused power into my eyes.

[The stigma ‘Fiery Golden Eyes (火眼金睛) Lv.???’ activates!]

Fiery Golden Eyes. The unique stigma of the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal, capable of identifying demons and devils.

The world’s colors slowly shifted, and the charging humans began changing appearance. Twisted forms, eyes filled with murderous intent. As expected, they were not human.

“Zhu Bajie isn’t our enemy.”

At my words, Lee Gilyoung’s eyes widened. He looked disappointed.

“Whaaat? Shit……”

“Zhu Bajie didn’t rule over this village. He liberated it. They’re the ones who made this village miserable. They aren’t humans; they’re the demons who ruled it.”

Having revealed their true colors, the slave demons released their Status and began destroying the village. Finally understanding, Lee Gilyoung and Shin Yoosung directed the people.

“Everyone, get back!”

……A revolution by factory slaves.

This was the complete opposite of the previous [Demon Realm Revolution].

Because this time, we had to suppress it, not liberate them.

Yoo Joonghyuk stepped forward first and started drawing the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] from his waist…… Wait, what was that?

[Some audience members are puzzled by Zhu Bajie’s weapon.]

[Several judges wonder why Zhu Bajie is using a ‘sword’.]

[Judge ‘Cleanser of Altars’ demands to know where his ‘Nine-Toothed Rake (上寶沁金鈀)’ has gone!]

According to the original, Zhu Bajie used not a sword, but a rake called the [Nine-Toothed Rake].

[Many audience members are overwhelmed by the presence of ‘Supreme King Zhu Bajie’!]

[Some audience members are utterly captivated by handsome Zhu Bajie’s charm!]

[Some judges accept the weapon change as a concession to popular appeal.]

[Judge ‘Cleanser of Altars’ clears his throat and says he will overlook it because it looks cool.]

[You have earned 5 bonus points!]

Damn it. Was his face itself probability?

Stepping forward, Yoo Joonghyuk suddenly pointed the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] at me, then drew a small circle around me.

“Do not leave that circle.”

“Pardon?”

“Move even one step, and I’ll kill you.”

Then the demons’ heads began falling.

The swordsmanship was breathtakingly beautiful.

Swordsmanship that had advanced even further than before. I could not imagine how much he had honed himself to reach such a level.

“Good job, pig!”

“You can do it!”

Before I knew it, Lee Gilyoung and Shin Yoosung had joined me to cheer him on.

We watched Yoo Joonghyuk defeat the army of demons alone.

[Judge ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ relaxes at this satisfying, comfortable development.]

At last, I understood Author Han Sooyoung-nim’s august intentions too.

Retired Sun Wukong was a truly wonderful story.

[Judge ‘Cleanser of Altars’ is intoxicated with how cool he is.]

[Judge ‘Meihouwang’ is slightly displeased by how cool Zhu Bajie looks.]

[You have earned 30 additional bonus points.]

Then a divine voice rang out from the sky.

[Wait! Stop!]

With screams, the half-dead demons prostrated themselves. The sky above the village opened, revealing a constellation dressed as a Daoist immortal.

Judging by the clothes, it had to be Taishang Laojun (太上老君).

[Supreme King Zhu Bajie, the creatures you are killing are pigs I raised at my Doushuai Palace. They fled for fear of ending up on the Heavenly Palace’s dining tables. Have compassion, and return them to me.]

There it was at last. That pattern.

Everything in ‘Journey to the West’ unfolded like this.

An incident occurred, the demon responsible was exposed, and once it had been defeated, some immortal appeared to say, “Actually, that demon was something I raised,” and took it away.

[Some judges award bonus points for a development faithful to the original!]

[30 bonus points have been added!]

Of course, with my twisted disposition, I could not let that pass without a word.

“If you were going to take them away like this, why didn’t you help from the beginning?”

[My apologies. I was rather busy……]

More likely he could not be bothered.

In fact, many of <Emperor>’s constellations knew everything happening in the scenarios yet hardly ever helped the incarnations.

“Take them.”

[Thank you.]

With Yoo Joonghyuk’s permission, Taishang Laojun ascended into the sky with his pigs.

(Once Taishang Laojun retrieved his pigs, peace returned to the village.)

In an ordinary story, that would have been the end.

But at that moment, my [Fiery Golden Eyes] stung, and the forms of the demons leaving with Taishang Laojun wavered violently.

【……don’t……want to……】

【……just how much longer……】

I heard the demons’ voices. Somehow familiar tones. Despite their lucky escape from death, they did not look happy at all. How should I put it?

Their expressions suggested they would rather have died here.

●

“The village is yours now. You’ll have to run the factory yourselves, but you won’t go hungry as you did before.”

Yoo Joonghyuk joined our party.

The villagers gave us a tearful send-off as we left.

More precisely, they seemed sorry that Yoo Joonghyuk was leaving, rather than us……

“Tsk. I wanted to beat him up and drag him along.”

After the farewell, Lee Gilyoung and Shin Yoosung set off again, and I followed them.

Yoo Joonghyuk trailed a few steps behind the party.

The atmosphere was awkward.

Come to think of it, I did not know how Yoo Joonghyuk and the companions got along when I was not there.

For some reason, he was on my mind, so I spoke.

“Junior brother, why don’t you walk a little closer?”

“……Who is your junior brother?”

Under his terrifying glare, I could not bring myself to say anything more.

Meanwhile, the children came up beside me, chattering happily.

“Demon King of Salvation, you were pretty good.”

“If you hadn’t exposed the demons, Disciple-nim, we would have been in trouble.”

In fact, I had done nothing. Yoo Joonghyuk had killed the demons, and Yoo Joonghyuk had saved the village. I had merely watched and added a few words. Yet the children were busy praising me instead of him.

I looked back at Yoo Joonghyuk. He was polishing his [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] as though he had heard nothing.

「At that moment, Kim Dokja wondered for the first time: ‘When I wasn’t there, what sort of presence was Yoo Joonghyuk among the companions?’」

Before long, night fell.

Warming ourselves at a fire made from gathered wood, we sat in a circle among the logs. It felt as though we were camping.

Yoo Joonghyuk was the one who abruptly threw cold water on that peaceful mood.

“From now on, I’ll act on my own.”

His voice was as indifferent as though he were cleaning his sword. Before I knew it, I asked,

“What do you mean?”

“We only need to go to India and bring back the ‘scriptures’, don’t we? I’m enough on my own. I’ll go there and—”

“You mustn’t!”

In truth, Zhu Bajie could reach India in an instant using his cloud technique, and I could do the same riding the Nimbus Cloud. Sun Wukong had actually said something similar in the original, and as a child, I had wondered the same thing.

「Why doesn’t Sun Wukong fetch the scriptures himself?」

Now, I understood that reason just a little.

“If you do that, this story will lose its meaning.”

Taking fourteen years to travel, little by little, a route they could cover there and back in a single night.

That time existed so that ‘Journey to the West’ could finally be completed.

But Yoo Joonghyuk thought differently.

“I don’t have time.”

“This journey won’t be that long. It won’t take fourteen years, so please be patient a little longer. Meeting the companions one by one as we travel might not be such a bad experience.”

Perhaps surprised to hear me say that, Yoo Joonghyuk gazed at me and spoke.

“You are not my companion.”

Of course.

There was no way someone as suspicious as Yoo Joonghyuk would trust me.

“I know.”

Silence settled over the party.

Lee Gilyoung wordlessly tossed a pebble into the fire. Watching Yoo Joonghyuk and me, Shin Yoosung scratched at the dirt with a finger.

Then a stomach growled. Lee Gilyoung rubbed his belly miserably.

“I’m hungry……”

Smiling, I took something from inside my clothes.

“Would you like a dumpling?”

It was my secret weapon: the dumplings I had finished on the ‘Road of Dumplings’ earlier.

Lee Gilyoung took one from me suspiciously, then bit into it. His eyes flickered like lanterns.

“What the heck! This is way better than the ones at the factory!”

Of course it would be delicious.

[Some audience members are extremely curious about the taste of ‘Murim Dumplings’!]

I felt Yoo Joonghyuk [999] twitch slightly on my shoulder.

I handed dumplings to Shin Yoosung and Yoo Joonghyuk as well.

Frowning, Yoo Joonghyuk shook his head.

“I don’t eat things made by other people.”

“They weren’t made by someone else.”

A question appeared in Yoo Joonghyuk’s eyes.

He probably did not understand what I meant.

Suspiciously eyeing the murim dumpling right in front of him, he carefully picked it up as though he had made a decision.

Then, very slowly, he brought it to his nose as though sizing up an enemy.

“……This smell?”

Yes. Eat that dumpling, you bastard.

After agonizing over it again and again, Yoo Joonghyuk slowly brought the dumpling to his mouth. Then, as if tearing out an enemy commander’s throat, he took a small bite.

Lee Gilyoung, Shin Yoosung, and I watched nervously as he chewed. Even the chef [999] on my shoulder waited stiffly for his reaction.

Gulp.

At last, after swallowing the first mouthful, Yoo Joonghyuk took another bite. Very slowly, the crease between his brows disappeared. His lips moved busily.

Little by little, he ate the dumpling faster. Two bites, three……

Finally, his hand moved toward a second dumpling. Stopping halfway, he glared at me.

“What are you looking at?”

I glanced away and began eating dumplings with them.

……Had I used [Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint], I could have heard much more interesting things. But I had decided not to use it on him anymore.

“……It’s reasonably edible.”

Hearing Yoo Joonghyuk’s quiet mutter, I looked up at the sky. The constellations shining there looked down on us, as though destruction were a tale from some distant world.

Eating dumplings like that, I thought for the first time.

I wished this story would go on a little longer.

●

[Deep night has fallen.]

[The ‘Journey to the West Remake’ system will undergo maintenance for one hour.]

Darkness lay thick over everything. It was a night when everyone slept.

Sun Wukong snored, using his arm as a pillow. The two Sanzangs, apparently exhausted as well, each slept with one of his legs as their pillow.

And under cover of night, with the audience’s and judges’ messages gone, a shadow quietly rose.

It was Yoo Joonghyuk.

He silently drew the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] from his waist and approached Sun Wukong.

Very slowly, he pointed its sharp tip at him.

With his blade pointed at Sun Wukong, Yoo Joonghyuk slowly spoke.

—How did you expect me to react, leaking demonic energy like that?

[Voice Transmission] was speech sent to a specific person. But Sun Wukong gave no answer.

Instead, the murim dumpling on his shoulder responded.

—The [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] is a fine blade.

At the depth of years in that voice, a faint aura formed over Yoo Joonghyuk’s blade.

The murim dumpling opened his eyes and quietly studied the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword], which held the power of transcendence, before speaking.

—But can you cut me with a broken blade like that?

Indeed, a faint crack ran through the middle of the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword].

He had patched it with repair tools sold in the [Dokkaebi Bag], but it was literally only a temporary measure. Having broken once, the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] could no longer exert even half its original power.

Yoo Joonghyuk spoke.

—We can find out right now.

—That is precisely why you had no choice but to lose to the ‘Secretive Plotter’.

At the words ‘Secretive Plotter,’ Yoo Joonghyuk’s thick eyebrows twitched sharply.

In the darkness, the murim dumpling’s shape began blurring, and Yoo Joonghyuk [999] regained his original form. Yoo Joonghyuk [999], like a tiny miniature.

Yoo Joonghyuk’s eyes wavered faintly.

—Are you that bastard’s subordinate? What did you come here for?

—As you are now, you can never defeat the ‘Secretive Plotter’.

—If you came to deliver that bullshit……

—The same would be true after hundreds of attempts. Just like your pathetic regressions. You know that, don’t you?

The tip of the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] trembled faintly.

Perhaps it was true. An enemy he had failed to defeat even after receiving Han Sooyoung’s and Jung Heewon’s power. Simply facing him again would not make Yoo Joonghyuk a match for him.

As though he understood those feelings, Yoo Joonghyuk [999] spoke.
